title: Mine and Yours
label: ch:it-possessivi
canDo: I can say whose something is, keep the article Italian keeps and drop it where Italian drops it, address somebody as signore or signora, and put a pronoun after a preposition.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson gives the stressed pronouns somewhere to stand. No preposition in this book had ever taken a pronoun after it, and per — Chapter 32's — is what makes per me sayable.
